The Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) gives the building a standard energy and carbon emission efficiency grade from 'A' to 'G', where 'A' is the most efficient and 'D' being the average to date.

Local life

Eaton Place is a prestigious Belgravia address well located for many fashionable shops, bars and restaurants along King's Road with Knightsbridge and the green open spaces of Hyde Park also within close proximity.
